technicalBlocker: No Chennai parcel polygon was obtained. The official eServices/TNGIS/CMDA application routes timed out before HTTP response; live GCC public GIS metadata exposes road and administrative boundaries, and the exact WUP point resolves only to ward 136. The public GCCPropertyTax folder listing is empty, while a separate GCCWebAppPublic folder explicitly requires a token.
remainingUncertainty: The exact TSLR town/block/ward/survey hierarchy and any public machine-readable TSLR geometry remain unresolved; the token-gated GCCWebAppPublic folder was not accessed further. This does not show that Chennai has no cadastral data.
nextStep: If an India-network route becomes available, inspect the public TSLR extract workflow from the official eServices landing page and resolve the WUP target to its town/block/ward/survey hierarchy; do not use the token-gated municipal folder without authorization.
